heading: Federal share

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Federal share of a grant made under this subchapter may not exceed 75 percent of the total costs of the program described in the application submitted under section 10615 of this title for the fiscal year for which the program receives assistance under this subchapter, unless the Attorney General waives, wholly or in part, the requirement of a matching contribution under this section.

tree.heading: In-kind contributions
tree.text: In-kind contributions may constitute a portion of the non-Federal share of a grant.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 3797u–5 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 90–351, title I, § 2956, as added Pub. L. 107–273, div. B, title II, § 2301(a), Nov. 2, 2002, 116 Stat. 1797.)
